goals.title: Challenge Modes at Game Start
goals.summary: Sword of Rage carries two alternate games that bypass the ordinary ruleset completely, offered as a selection when a game starts. Each is a self-contained multiball with a leaderboard of its own, kept apart from the standard game's champions.
instructions: The two challenge modes are offered as a selection at game start rather than earned during play
Retro Black Knight Multiball starts with 3 balls already in play
In it the score multiplier is set by the number of balls in play, so keeping all three alive is the whole game
Once you drain down to a single ball, a timer counts down for 10 seconds until the flippers lose power and the mode ends
The King's Ransom Multiball challenge runs a 60 second mode timer with unlimited balls in play until the timer ends
Each challenge keeps its own champion entry, separate from the standard game
goals.reward: A standalone Retro Black Knight Multiball or The King's Ransom Multiball, each with unique high score leaderboards

drills.title: Held Plunge to Center
drills.text: Hold the left flipper through the plunge so the ball comes down to the flippers, then take the center target. Each successive one you make is worth more than the last, so this is a plunge to bank every ball rather than a one-off.

drills.title: Backhand Everything
drills.text: Cradle and backhand the center shots, and take the shield scoop as a backhand off the right flipper rather than shooting it from the left. The rubber posts sit close to the flippers, so a missed forehand comes back down the middle — the orbits are the only shots worth taking forehand.

drills.title: Right Drop Bank
drills.text: Backhand the right three-bank until the whole bank is down, then do it again. It charges the sword meter and it is how you relight your primary drain defense, so it needs to be a shot you can take on demand rather than one you stumble into.

drills.title: Magna-Save Press
drills.text: Press the button as the ball drifts toward the right outlane, not after it commits. Relight it on the right drops immediately afterwards — the save also cashes every Super you have running, so a save you cannot make twice is a save you cannot plan around.

drills.title: U-Turn Loop
drills.text: Shoot an orbit to arm the U-Turn, then keep shooting that same orbit with nothing in between. Any other shot resets the chain, so the discipline is refusing the shots the return offers you on the way past.

drills.title: Complete WAR, Cash Fast
drills.text: Lane-change the three top lanes to complete the set, then cash the hurry-up quickly on the flail ramp and finish at the center target. The value decays while you decide, so pick your first shot before the lanes complete.

actionButton.label: Magna-Save
actionButton.how: The lockdown bar button is your Magna-Save, wired to a magnet tucked above the right outlane. Press it as a ball drifts toward that outlane and the magnet snatches it before it drains. It doubles as the cash register: a successful save also pays out every Super Mode you have running.

That cash-out gets multiplied by balls in play, up to 3x — the biggest single collect on the game.

howItPlays.objective: Black Knight: Sword of Rage is a punishing retro Stern where the Magna-Save button is both your drain defense and your cash register. Win the monster battles to open the Black Castle, and spell K-N-I-G-H-T for a multiball that multiplies every point by the balls in play.
loop: Light SUPER on the left spinner, start a Super Mode at the center target, and boost it at the left lane until its icon glows purple.
Complete the W-A-R top lanes, nudging the lit lane over with a flipper tap, to bump Bonus X and flash the center shots for a decaying hurry-up.
Qualify a monster battle at the center shots, raise the shield with the flail ramp, and start the battle and a lock together at the shield scoop.

Bank K-N-I-G-H-T letters as you win battles, finish WAR hurry-ups, and cash Triple Knights jackpots, then run KNIGHT Multiball from the left spinner lane and empty your boosted Supers into a Magna-Save.
Win all five battles to unlock the Black Castle, beat the Black Knight, and set off the six-ball RAGE Multiball.

lights.name: W-A-R Top Lanes
lights.lit: The three top lanes spell W-A-R, and a lit lane is a letter still open, so roll through it to bank that letter.

control.effect: tap a flipper button to shift which of the W, A, and R lanes is lit, sliding it toward the lane the ball is rolling down
control.when: as the ball crosses the top lanes

lights.then: Complete W-A-R to step Bonus X and flash the three center shots white for a fast-decaying hurry-up - bank it quickly at the flail ramp and end at the center target for a KNIGHT letter. Bonus X holds from ball to ball, so it keeps paying later.

lights.name: Super Modes
lights.lit: Ripping the left spinner lights SUPER at the center target, and starting one turns on an untimed Super Mode that keeps scoring until you deliberately cash it.
lights.then: Stack several Supers - Super Spinner is by far the richest - and boost each at the left lane until its icon turns purple. Then dump the whole pile with a Magna-Save, ideally inside 3x KNIGHT Multiball, where they pour out 200 to 300M.

lights.name: Magna-Save
lights.lit: The Magna-Save insert glows when the magnet above the right outlane is armed, and a dark one will not fire until you relight it on the right drop bank.

control.effect: press the lockbar button as a ball drifts toward the right outlane and the magnet grabs it before it can drain
control.when: the moment the ball heads for the right outlane

lights.then: Each save also rings up every Super Mode you have running as one Super Jackpot and then ends them. Time that cash-out for KNIGHT Multiball and it is multiplied by the balls in play, up to 3x - the single biggest collect on the game.

lights.name: Monster Battles
lights.lit: Hitting the lit center shots qualifies a battle - a spinning wheel decides the monster - and the flail ramp then raises the shield to expose the scoop that starts it.
lights.then: The scoop starts the battle and locks a ball at the same time, so you always drag a mode into multiball. Each of the five battles you win, from the Hydra's Mud Bog to the Magma Beast's Molten Fire, awards a KNIGHT letter, lights an Extra Ball, and counts toward the Black Castle.

lights.name: K-N-I-G-H-T
lights.lit: Letters of K-N-I-G-H-T light as you earn them - winning battles, finishing WAR rounds, cashing Triple Knights super jackpots - with K and N already lit at the start.
lights.then: Spell the word to light the left spinner lane, and shooting it runs KNIGHT Multiball, where playfield scoring is multiplied by the balls in play up to 3x - the money window you save your boosted Supers for. A second spelling instead starts The King's Ransom, a low-risk multiball with unlimited ball save and a free +5x Bonus X.

lights.name: Triple Knights Lock
lights.lit: The small light-lock standup lights the scoop for a lock - one hit for the first multiball, more for each after - and the exposed scoop banks the ball.
lights.then: Lock three balls to start, then run the phase jackpots on the spinner, ramp, and scoop to light a Super Jackpot at the ramp worth triple, plus another KNIGHT letter. Because a battle and this lock both live at the scoop, nearly the same shot arms both.

lights.name: U-Turn Loop
lights.lit: One orbit shot turns the arrow in front of it red to arm a U-Turn, and looping the same orbit again with no other shot in between escalates the value.
lights.then: Keep the U-Turns going, watching the lightning-bolt inserts change color as the value climbs, until an Extra Ball lights at the shield scoop. It is the game's one true combo and its most repeatable route to a free ball.

lights.name: Black Castle
lights.lit: Winning all five monster battles lights the scoop for Black Castle, the showdown against the Black Knight himself.
lights.then: Clear the inner center shots to light four outer loops, complete those loops as the flail spins harder and the shield kicks back meaner, then land the final scoop shot. That blow triggers RAGE Multiball, a six-ball frenzy on the always-lit center target and the game's capstone.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Tap a flipper button to slide which of the W, A, and R top lanes is lit toward the lane the ball is rolling down, then let it roll through to bank that letter. Completing W-A-R steps the Bonus X - which sticks from ball to ball - and flashes the center shots for a hurry-up that ends in a KNIGHT letter.

scoring.text: Hold the left flipper through the plunge for the Super Skill Shot into a center target, then backhand the right drops to arm Magna-Save, your lifeline against the right outlane. Finish the W-A-R lanes for that first hurry-up and a step of Bonus X, and cradle to backhand almost everything, since the close posts punish loose forehands.

Charge Super Modes to purple - Super Spinner above all - before you ever start KNIGHT Multiball, because boosting shuts off during it. Stack a monster battle with the Triple Knights lock at the scoop, and grab The Power from the right drops for 2x scoring inside a fresh battle.

Win all five monster battles to open the Black Castle, beat the Black Knight, and set off the six-ball RAGE Multiball, the repeatable summit of the game. The largest single collect, though, is a pile of purple Supers cashed with a Magna-Save inside 3x KNIGHT Multiball.
